firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited a beach goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Starting feature tiles are chosen in reverse turn order during setup. That does not change who takes the first turn.
